title: Better Music Variety
description: A datapack that adds more music.
body:
# **Current Songs:**

**Current songs include:**
- One Headlight
- Money For Nothing
- Just Like You
- California Love
- Wipeout
- Runaway
- FLY
- Sweet Emotion
- You Really Got Me
- Semi-Charmed Life
- Need You Tonight

# **Commands:**
Run the command **"/function bettermusicavariety:song"** to get all of the music disc's

# **Recipes (NEW):**
Recipes have just been added into the game for survival compatability. 

**Steps:**
1. Obtain a normal music disk
2. Put the music disk into a crafting table (It should be able to be crafted into a "blank disc"
3. Combine this "blank disc" with a diamond (Must use the minecraft quick crafting. Must also look up the name of the song.)
4. Craft your correct disk.

If you are confused with any of these steps you can look at the gallery for an image demonstration.

# **Suggestions/Bugs:**
If you have any suggestions or bugs that need to be fixed. Join our Discord server!



_Songs need to have both the datapack and texturepack installed in order for the songs to be proporly played._
